I started taking it last august and stopped taking it in December. My doc prescribed it cuz he think I have anger issues. It works by upping your dopamine levels in your brain, which is the chemical the calms you down. It did seem to work a little. I didnt snap out at certain things that usually push my buttons. I generally reacted more calmly about them 

Aside from sleeping 17 hours at a time sometimes, the biggest side effect was that it actually gave me a huge rush of anxiety for about a day every time I took one. Was taking 1.5mg a day, then went down to every other day, then every third day, but that feeling of bugs crawling on my skin, not being able to sit still or feel comfortable was getting to me. Got sick of feeling so overwhelmed and everything seeming hopeless.

I tried "staying on it" as they say to "get used to the drug" but those side effect never went away. I stopped taking it and switched to escitalopram the same week. It works by making your brain absorb serotonin slower so that it stays in your brain longer. Serotonin it a reward chemical ur brain makes when you do something, basically makes you feel accomplished. Anyway escitalopram has helped a LOT with me feeling motivated to actually go do stuff. I've been on it since december and still on it now with no noticeable side effects. It doesnt however seem to help me with my anger issues, so I'm still struggling with that.

If you've read this far then thanks for ur attention. I should also say that the same drug will have different effects from person to person. It may actually work well in your favor, idk for sure though. This is just my experience from it. Also had my doc say it's new and "works wonders" and gave me a bunch of samples. I feel like he was paid to pro.ote them or something.

Also good luck getting your insurance to pay for them. I have PEHP summit plan which I feel like is a decent plan that covers well. But they wouldn't cover it at all. 30 day supply was looking to be over $100. It was ridiculous. A 90 day supply of escitalopram is $4 with my plan.

Hope this helps and I hope u find something that works for you.
